evidence.requirements: Most of the brief is met. The list has the heading, name links, family and L3, plus Search over alternative names (model.js:109-115 strips whitespace, so '7,62 x 51' matches), the Family select and the count. The detail view has every fact, the water capacity with its source link (app.js:51-68), Symbol/Value/Unit tables grouped by section with tolerances folded into the value (model.js:78-91), Print and All cartridges, and a hash route that survives a reload (app.js:113-129). The SVG has the name '<name> drawing' (drawing.js:247), both halves, a dash-dot axis, every required dimension (drawing.js:93-123, 158-176) and a title block. Partly met: the title block always says 'Scale 1:1 (1 unit = 1 mm)' (drawing.js:243), but the SVG is scaled to the container, so the stated scale is wrong on screen and on paper (print-308_win.jpg shows the 308 drawn at about 2.5×). Rule 8's section shows the bullet cutting into the case wall on straight cases (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-44_rem_mag.jpg). A count of 1 reads '1 cartridge' (model.js:125-127), not '<n> cartridges'. A missing r1 min (338 Lapua) is skipped with no note, though the brief asks for rounding only where published.
evidence.correctness: geometry.js follows the rules closely. The rim type is decided by the R1/P1 ratio (16-23). The chamfer uses min(f·tanβ, R1/4) (92-96). The groove floor and ramp are correct, and the belted ramp at δ runs to R3 then the belt to E (105-118); detail-300_win_mag.jpg shows the belt and matches reference/300_win_mag.png. The rimfire half-round rim (82-90) and heeled bullet (173-175) show in detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, matching reference/22_long_rifle.png. Shoulder fillets use r1Min and r2. The tangent ogive is correct (194-202), as are the quarter ellipse and the SWC/flat cone. Seating and cylinder factors (176-185), tb/tn, w and the primer pockets (6-14, 161-165) match the brief. Proportions in detail-308_win.jpg and detail-9_mm_luger.jpg match the reference drawings. Defects: (1) on straight cases the inner wall at the mouth is H2/2 - tb (geometry.js:168), which is smaller than G1/2 (9 mm Luger: 4.225 vs 4.515). The seated bullet overlaps the cut wall as a dark band in detail-9_mm_luger.jpg and detail-44_rem_mag.jpg. (2) 'Scale 1:1' is false. (3) L2, R and L3 labels are pushed outside the dimension, to the left of the head (detail-308_win.jpg 'L2 43.48 -0.2'), and the α label sits far above the shoulder on a long leader, which makes them ambiguous. Values, tolerances (e.g. 'L1 39.62 -0.2') and DMS angles ('10°58'00"') match the data. The print fits one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.security: The only innerHTML is the SVG string (app.js:96); every data string inside it goes through esc() (drawing.js:15, 236-247), and a test checks this (drawing.test.js:60-66). The rest of the DOM uses textContent/setAttribute through h() (app.js:6-15). There is no eval, fetch, CDN or web font, and the data is embedded in cartridges.js.
evidence.code_quality: The four modules are small and clearly separated: model (format, filter), geometry (profile), drawing (layout, SVG) and app (DOM, routing). Names follow the brief's symbols, and missing values are handled through need() and notes (geometry.js:64-68). Drawing.plan is a long function with many magic constants (drawing.js:3-13, 69-215), and segHitsRect is duplicated in the test (drawing.test.js:8-19). The globals use var IIFEs, which suits file://. The size fits the task.
evidence.tests: There are 37 node:test cases with no dependencies. They cover formatting, tolerances, symbols, units, search with '7,62 x 51', the family filter and the count (model.test.js). Geometry tests cover rim types, chamfer, groove, belt, rimfire rim, heeled bullet, ogive arc radius, ellipse, SWC, walls, pockets, missing-value notes and a self-intersection check on every record (geometry.test.js). Drawing tests check that no label overlaps another label or the outline across all 25 records (drawing.test.js:39-50). Gaps: no test of bullet versus case-wall overlap (the visible defect passes), no DOM, routing or print tests, and one test asserts the incorrect 'Scale 1:1' (drawing.test.js:57).
evidence.ux_design: The facts list and the tables are dense and tabular (detail-*.jpg). The drawing, however, takes only the middle of a wide bordered figure. Labels at 2.8 mm are large relative to small cartridges, and the 66 mm title block dominates the 22 LR and 9 mm drawings (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). Some row labels are detached from their lines (L2 and R float left of the head) and the α label is far from the shoulder. In the tables the 'Value' header is left-aligned while the values are right-aligned, leaving wide gaps (detail-308_win.jpg). The print layout is compact and black on white, with a 3-column facts grid and a 4-column table flow (print-308_win.jpg), but the tables print at 6.2 pt. Dark mode exists in CSS only (app.css:15-25).
evidence.accessibility: The SVG has role=img and aria-label '<name> drawing' (drawing.js:247). Table headers use scope=col (app.js:76-79), inputs have label for= (app.js:44-45), the count is aria-live (app.js:31), and there are :focus-visible outlines (app.css:47-50) and lang=en. Contrast of the muted text #5d646c on #fbfbf9 is about 5.9:1. Gaps: the drawing has no longer description or figcaption, tables have no captions (the h3 is not linked to its table), and there is no skip link.
evidence.simplicity: No runtime or dev dependencies (package.json), five plain JS files of roughly 800 lines in total, and data embedded as JSONL. The size fits the problem.
evidence.maintainability: There is no README, no docs, no ADRs or specs, no CI configuration, no engines field or .nvmrc pinning Node 22, and no changelog or release notes; package.json has only version 0.1.0 and a test script. A newcomer would have to infer that index.html is opened directly and that tests run with 'npm test'. The test suite is the only regression safety net.
evidence.visual_design: Calm system typography, a restrained palette and tabular numbers make it look tidy (list.jpg). The drawing looks unbalanced: the drawing is set in a large empty bordered box, its labels and title block are oversized, and the label positions are inconsistent (some above or left, α far right). Table headers are misaligned with the right-aligned values. The site footer and source line are fine. It looks only partly finished.
evidence.layout: The list uses a two-column grid with clear filters (list.jpg). The detail order follows the brief (facts, drawing, tables), so the drawing sits below the fold-level facts. The figure wastes horizontal space for short cartridges (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, detail-9_mm_luger.jpg). The two-column tables are long, with empty space on the shorter side. Print fits one page with no clipping (print-308_win.jpg). No label overlaps are visible.
evidence.usability: Live search and the family filter, name links, a hash URL per cartridge, an 'All cartridges' back link, a Print button and a not-found page (app.js:86-89) let users find a cartridge and read or print its data in one or two steps. The primer type shows the raw code ('lr') without explanation.
evidence.reception: Reloaders and engineers would find the data complete and accurate and the print sheet useful. A title block claiming 'Scale 1:1' on a drawing that is clearly not 1:1, and bullets drawn through the case wall in the pistol section views, would undermine trust with gunsmiths and engineers. The reference sheet looks plain but credible.

unmet_requirements: Title block scale: 'Scale 1:1 (1 unit = 1 mm)' is shown regardless of the rendered size, which is false on screen and in print (drawing.js:243)
Section rule 8 on straight cases: the inner wall at the mouth uses tb, so the seated bullet (G1) overlaps the cut case wall (geometry.js:168; detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-44_rem_mag.jpg)
Count text is '1 cartridge' for a single result instead of '<n> cartridges' (model.js:125-127)
Some dimension labels (L2, R, L3 on short cases, α) are placed away from their dimension lines and read ambiguously, though they do not overlap
strengths: The geometry rules are implemented faithfully and tested: chamfer, groove, belt at δ, rimfire half-round rim, heeled bullet, tangent ogive, ellipse and cone noses, fillets, primer pockets and head thickness. Outlines match the OpenBallistics references.
Dependency-free plain JS that works from file://. Rendering is safe: every data string in the SVG is escaped and there are no network requests.
Label placement is collision-checked and tested across all 25 records, and the printed detail view fits one A4 page with the header, drawing, tables and source footer.
issues: The title block states 'Scale 1:1' on a drawing that is scaled to the screen or paper, a factual error on a technical drawing for engineers (drawing.js:243), and a test asserts it.

Straight-case section views draw the seated bullet through the case wall, because the mouth inner radius H2/2 - tb is smaller than G1/2 (geometry.js:168; visible in the 9 mm Luger and 44 Rem. Mag. screenshots).

No README, docs, ADRs, CI or Node version pin, which makes it hard to hand over. The drawing presentation is also unpolished: oversized title block and labels, detached L2/R/α labels, and misaligned table headers.
review.verdict: The app meets nearly every functional requirement, and its cartridge geometry follows the brief's rules closely, backed by meaningful tests and safe, dependency-free code. A false 'Scale 1:1' claim, bullets drawn through the case wall on straight cases, an unpolished drawing presentation and missing project documentation keep it from being publishable as is.
